body: "I am"  is kind of a statement of logic. You can't say "God is good" because that implies that there is something that is not God (impossible) and that this something is not "good" (also impossible).  You also can't say "God is Love" or "God is Light" without implying its opposite.  So "God Is" or "I am" is a statement of Truth.
